remarks: Rare opportunity to own approximately 2.18 acres on Casey Road in the Williamsville School District and create a truly custom home from the ground up. Offered as vacant land at $550,000, this property provides the flexibility to bring your own vision to life and design the home, site layout, driveway, outdoor living spaces, pool, landscaping, and yard around the way you want to live. The property is also being offered as a custom to be built opportunity with Brownstone Homes under MLS #B1715985 at a list price of $3,150,000. That offering includes a proposed approximately 6,400 square feet of finished living space, although buyers may modify the proposed design or work with the Brownstone Homes design team to create an entirely different custom home. See cross referenced residential listing for additional renderings, proposed specifications, and build information.
